procedure.name: Q2
procedure.statement: WITH europe_stock AS ( SELECT s_i_id, s_quantity, su_suppkey, su_name, su_address, su_phone, su_comment, n_name FROM stock, supplier, nation, region WHERE MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name LIKE 'Europ%' ), min_qty AS ( SELECT s_i_id AS m_i_id, MIN(s_quantity) AS m_s_quantity FROM europe_stock GROUP BY s_i_id ) SELECT su_suppkey, su_name, n_name, i_id, i_name, su_address, su_phone, su_comment FROM item, europe_stock, min_qty WHERE i_id = europe_stock.s_i_id AND i_data LIKE '%b' AND i_id = m_i_id AND europe_stock.s_quantity = m_s_quantity ORDER BY n_name, su_name, i_id

procedure.name: Q3
procedure.statement: SELECT ol_o_id, ol_w_id, ol_d_id, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue, o_entry_d FROM customer, new_order, oorder, order_line WHERE c_state LIKE 'A%' AND c_key = o_c_key AND no_key = o_key AND ol_o_key = o_key AND o_entry_d > '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY ol_o_id, ol_w_id, ol_d_id, o_entry_d ORDER BY revenue DESC, o_entry_d

procedure.name: Q4
procedure.statement: SELECT o.o_ol_cnt, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM oorder o LEFT JOIN order_line ol ON o.o_key = ol.ol_o_key AND ol.ol_delivery_d >= o.o_entry_d WHERE ol.ol_o_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_ol_cnt ORDER BY o.o_ol_cnt

procedure.name: Q5
procedure.statement: SELECT n_name, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM customer, oorder, order_line, stock, supplier, nation, region WHERE c_key = o_c_key AND ol_o_key = o_key AND ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND c_state_key = su_nationkey AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND r_name = 'Europe' AND o_entry_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

procedure.name: Q7
procedure.statement: SELECT su_nationkey AS supp_nation, SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) AS cust_nation, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_entry_d) AS l_year, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM supplier, stock, order_line, oorder, customer, nation n1, nation n2 WHERE ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND ol_o_key = o_key AND c_key = o_c_key AND su_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey AND c_state_key = n2.n_nationkey AND ((n1.n_name = 'Germany' AND n2.n_name = 'Cambodia') OR (n1.n_name = 'Cambodia' AND n2.n_name = 'Germany')) GROUP BY su_nationkey, cust_nation, l_year ORDER BY su_nationkey, cust_nation, l_year

procedure.name: Q8
procedure.statement: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_entry_d) AS l_year, sum(CASE WHEN n2.n_name = 'Germany' THEN ol_amount ELSE 0 END) / sum(ol_amount) AS mkt_share FROM item, supplier, stock, order_line, oorder, customer, nation n1, nation n2, region WHERE i_id = s_i_id AND ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND ol_o_key = o_key AND c_key = o_c_key AND n1.n_nationkey = c_state_key AND n1.n_regionkey = r_regionkey AND ol_i_id < 1000 AND r_name = 'Europe' AND su_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey AND i_data LIKE '%b' AND i_id = ol_i_id GROUP BY l_year ORDER BY l_year

procedure.name: Q9
procedure.statement: SELECT n_name, extract(YEAR FROM o_entry_d) AS l_year, sum(ol_amount) AS sum_profit FROM item, stock, supplier, order_line, oorder, nation WHERE ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key AND MOD((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND ol_o_key = o_key AND ol_i_id = i_id AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND i_data LIKE '%bb' GROUP BY n_name, l_year ORDER BY n_name, l_year DESC

procedure.name: Q10
procedure.statement: SELECT c_id, c_last, sum(ol_amount) AS revenue, c_city, c_phone, n_name FROM customer, oorder, order_line, nation WHERE c_key = o_c_key AND ol_o_key = o_key AND o_entry_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' AND o_entry_d <= ol_delivery_d AND n_nationkey = c_state_key GROUP BY c_id, c_last, c_city, c_phone, n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

procedure.name: Q11
procedure.statement: WITH germany_stock AS ( SELECT s_i_id, sum(s_order_cnt) AS ordercount FROM stock, supplier, nation WHERE mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey AND su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'Germany' GROUP BY s_i_id ) SELECT s_i_id, ordercount FROM germany_stock WHERE ordercount > (SELECT sum(ordercount) * 0.005 FROM germany_stock) ORDER BY ordercount DESC

procedure.name: Q12
procedure.statement: SELECT o_ol_cnt, sum(CASE WHEN o_carrier_id = 1 OR o_carrier_id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_line_count, sum(CASE WHEN o_carrier_id != 1 AND o_carrier_id != 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_line_count FROM oorder, order_line WHERE ol_o_key = o_key AND o_entry_d <= ol_delivery_d AND ol_delivery_d < '2020-01-01 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY o_ol_cnt ORDER BY o_ol_cnt

procedure.name: Q13
procedure.statement: SELECT c_count, count(*) AS custdist FROM ( SELECT c_id, count(o_id) AS c_count FROM customer LEFT OUTER JOIN oorder ON (c_key = o_c_key AND o_carrier_id > 8) GROUP BY c_id ) AS c_orders GROUP BY c_count ORDER BY custdist DESC, c_count DESC

procedure.name: Q15
procedure.statement: UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

WITH revenue0 AS ( SELECT mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) AS supplier_no, sum(ol_amount) AS total_revenue FROM order_line, stock WHERE ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key AND ol_delivery_d >= '2007-01-02 00:00:00.000000' GROUP BY supplier_no ) SELECT su_suppkey, su_name, su_address, su_phone, total_revenue FROM supplier, revenue0 WHERE su_suppkey = supplier_no AND total_revenue = (SELECT max(total_revenue) FROM revenue0) ORDER BY su_suppkey
UPDATE supplier SET su_suppkey = su_suppkey WHERE 1 = 0

procedure.name: Q17
procedure.statement: WITH item_avg AS ( SELECT i_id, AVG(ol_quantity) AS a FROM item, order_line WHERE i_data LIKE '%b' AND ol_i_id = i_id GROUP BY i_id ) SELECT SUM(ol_amount) / 2.0 AS avg_yearly FROM order_line, item_avg WHERE ol_i_id = item_avg.i_id AND ol_quantity < item_avg.a

procedure.name: Q18
procedure.statement: SELECT c_last, c_id, o_id, o_entry_d, o_ol_cnt, sum(ol_amount) AS amount_sum FROM customer, oorder, order_line WHERE c_key = o_c_key AND ol_o_key = o_key GROUP BY o_id, o_w_id, o_d_id, c_id, c_last, o_entry_d, o_ol_cnt HAVING sum(ol_amount) > 200 ORDER BY amount_sum DESC, o_entry_d

procedure.name: Q19
procedure.statement: SELECT SUM(ol_amount) AS revenue FROM order_line JOIN item ON ol_i_id = i_id WHERE ol_quantity >= 1 AND ol_quantity <= 10 AND i_price BETWEEN 1 AND 400000 AND ( (i_data LIKE '%a' AND ol_w_id IN (1, 2, 3)) OR (i_data LIKE '%b' AND ol_w_id IN (1, 2, 4)) OR (i_data LIKE '%c' AND ol_w_id IN (1, 5, 3)) )

procedure.name: Q21
procedure.statement: SELECT su_name, COUNT(*) AS numwait FROM supplier JOIN nation ON su_nationkey = n_nationkey AND n_name = 'Germany' JOIN stock ON mod((s_w_id * s_i_id), 10000) = su_suppkey JOIN order_line l1 ON l1.ol_w_i_key = s_w_i_key JOIN oorder ON l1.ol_o_key = o_key AND l1.ol_delivery_d > o_entry_d LEFT JOIN order_line l2 ON l2.ol_o_key = l1.ol_o_key AND l2.ol_delivery_d > l1.ol_delivery_d WHERE l2.ol_o_key IS NULL GROUP BY su_name ORDER BY numwait DESC, su_name

procedure.name: Q22
procedure.statement: WITH avg_balance AS ( SELECT AVG(c_balance) AS threshold FROM customer WHERE c_balance > 0.00 AND SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') ) SELECT SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) AS country, COUNT(*) AS numcust, SUM(c_balance) AS totacctbal FROM customer CROSS JOIN avg_balance LEFT JOIN oorder ON o_c_key = c_key WHERE SUBSTRING(c_phone FROM 1 FOR 1) IN ('1','2','3','4','5','6','7') AND c_balance > avg_balance.threshold AND o_c_key IS NULL GROUP BY SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1) ORDER BY SUBSTRING(c_state FROM 1 FOR 1)
